scenarios.title: A｜灯 / 插座不能使用
scenarios.setting: 在“电器与设备故障”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“灯 / 插座不能使用”。

turns.prompt: 你想描述遇到的故障并寻求处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, one of the lights in my room isn’t working.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, one of the lights in my room isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: “one of the lights”指出只有其中一盏灯有问题，便于缩小检查范围。

choices.text: The outlet next to the bed doesn’t seem to work.

feedback.naturalExpression: The outlet next to the bed doesn’t seem to work.
feedback.explanation: “doesn't seem to work”说明设备看起来无法正常运作，保留了进一步检查的余地。

choices.text: I can’t get any power from this outlet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t get any power from this outlet.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: None of the lights in the bathroom will turn on.

feedback.naturalExpression: None of the lights in the bathroom will turn on.
feedback.explanation: “turn on”表示开启设备电源；它与打开门或盒子的“open”不同。

choices.text: The plug doesn’t have electricity.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, one of the lights in my room isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: “plug”是插头，“outlet / socket”是插座；如果插座没电，说“The outlet isn’t working”更明确。

turns.text: Have you tried the other outlets in the room?

turns.prompt: 关于「电器与设备故障」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, the others are working fine.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, the others are working fine.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes. It seems to be just this one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It seems to be just this one.
feedback.explanation: 把结论说成基于现有信息的判断，给后续核实或纠正留出余地。

choices.text: No, I’ll check them now.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I’ll check them now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: We can have maintenance take a look.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That would be great. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be great. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Sure. When can someone come?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. When can someone come?
feedback.explanation: 询问时间或时机，便于对方给出具体安排，减少对等待或操作时间的猜测。

choices.text: Thanks. There’s no rush, but I’d like to have it fixed today.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. There’s no rush, but I’d like to have it fixed today.
feedback.explanation: “no rush”表示不着急，能让对方知道时间安排可以从容一些。

scenarios.title: B｜电视 / 遥控器故障
scenarios.setting: 在“电器与设备故障”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“电视 / 遥控器故障”。

turns.prompt: 关于「电器与设备故障」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I can’t get the TV to turn on.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I can’t get the TV to turn on.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: The remote control doesn’t seem to be working.

feedback.naturalExpression: The remote control doesn’t seem to be working.
feedback.explanation: “doesn't seem to be working”说明设备看起来无法正常运作，保留了进一步检查的余地。

choices.text: I think there’s something wrong with the TV.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think there’s something wrong with the TV.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: The TV is on, but there’s no picture.

feedback.naturalExpression: The TV is on, but there’s no picture.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: My television can’t open.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I can’t get the TV to turn on.
feedback.explanation: 电视无法开机用“won’t turn on”，而不是“can’t open”；“open”通常用于盖子、门或文件等。

turns.text: Have you tried using the power button on the TV itself?

turns.prompt: 关于「电器与设备故障」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, but it still won’t turn on.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but it still won’t turn on.
feedback.explanation: “turn on”表示开启设备电源；它与打开门或盒子的“open”不同。

choices.text: No, let me try that.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, let me try that.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: The TV works with the button, so I think it’s the remote.

feedback.naturalExpression: The TV works with the button, so I think it’s the remote.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: In that case, we can bring you another remote.

turns.prompt: 你想和前台确认更换用品的送达安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: That would be great. Could you send one up?

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be great. Could you send one up?
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Perfect. I’m in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’m in room 806.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: Thanks. Hopefully that will fix it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Hopefully that will fix it.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。

scenarios.title: C｜冰箱不制冷
scenarios.setting: 在“电器与设备故障”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“冰箱不制冷”。

turns.prompt: 关于「电器与设备故障」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, the refrigerator in my room doesn’t seem to be cold.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: The mini-fridge in my room isn’t cooling properly.
feedback.explanation: 这句本身自然；“isn’t cooling properly”更侧重冰箱的制冷功能，而不是设备表面冷不冷。

choices.text: The mini-fridge in my room isn’t cooling properly.

feedback.naturalExpression: The mini-fridge in my room isn’t cooling properly.
feedback.explanation: “isn’t cooling”说明设备不制冷，便于针对制冷功能检查。

choices.text: I put some drinks in the fridge, but they’re still warm.

feedback.naturalExpression: I put some drinks in the fridge, but they’re still warm.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I don’t think the fridge is working.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think the fridge is working.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: My refrigerator doesn’t make cold.

feedback.naturalExpression: The mini-fridge in my room isn’t cooling properly.
feedback.explanation: 冰箱制冷用“cool”，不说“make cold”；“isn’t cooling properly”能准确描述功能问题。

turns.text: I see. Is the fridge running at all?

turns.prompt: 关于「电器与设备故障」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, but it isn’t getting cold.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but it isn’t getting cold.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I don’t think it’s running at all.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think it’s running at all.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’m not sure. I can’t hear anything from it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. I can’t hear anything from it.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: We’ll have someone check it for you.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I have some food that needs to stay cold.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I have some food that needs to stay cold.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Could you send someone up soon, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send someone up soon, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there somewhere else I can keep my food in the meantime?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there somewhere else I can keep my food in the meantime?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

scenarios.title: D｜保险箱打不开
scenarios.setting: 在“电器与设备故障”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“保险箱打不开”。

turns.prompt: 关于「电器与设备故障」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m having trouble opening the safe in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m having trouble opening the safe in my room.
feedback.explanation: 说明正在尝试的动作或遇到的困难，帮助对方针对卡住的环节提供协助。

choices.text: The safe won’t open.

feedback.naturalExpression: The safe won’t open.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I entered the code, but the safe is still locked.

feedback.naturalExpression: I entered the code, but the safe is still locked.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I think I’ve accidentally locked myself out of the safe.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ve accidentally locked myself out of the safe.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I can’t open my safety box.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m having trouble opening the safe in my room.
feedback.explanation: 客房保险箱通常叫“safe”；“safety box”能猜到意思，但不是这里最常见的名称。

turns.text: Are any of your belongings inside?

turns.prompt: 你想说明保险箱内是否有自己的物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, my passport is inside.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, my passport is inside.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes, I have some valuables in there.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I have some valuables in there.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: No, fortunately it’s empty. I just can’t use it.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, fortunately it’s empty. I just can’t use it.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

turns.text: We’ll need to send someone up to unlock it for you.

turns.prompt: 你想确认打开保险箱前需要配合什么，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you need to see my ID first?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you need to see my ID first?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Okay. How soon can someone come?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. How soon can someone come?
feedback.explanation: “How soon”问多快能办到，强调从现在起还要等多久。

choices.text: Great. I’ll wait in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll wait in the room.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
